permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Routes from the free OpenStreetMap server of FOSSGIS e.V. (Valhalla), place search with Photon (komoot), overview streets and, only if switched on, charging stations from OpenStreetMap via the public Overpass API (overpass-api.de). Or your own servers.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Route from where you are and show how far the next turn is. Your position is never stored.
